Name: UI Info Suite 2
Author: Abs0rbed
Description:
This mod is a rewrite of cdaragorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1150]UIInfoSuite[/url] mod (which is based on Demiacle's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1023/?]UiModSuite[/url]), so 99% of the credit goes to those guys. Annosz's contribution started after December 2019 when the original project was abandoned. As this is a very useful mod, they wanted to continue providing support for newer game versions, fixing bugs and adding new requested features, so here we are! The current version is the combined effort of several contributors including [url=https://github.com/drewhoener]Abs0rbed[/url] and [url=https://github.com/tqdv]tqdv[/url].

The current features include:
[list]
[*]Display an icon that represents the current day's luck
[*]Display experience point gains
[*]Display a dynamic experience bar that changes based on your current tool or location
[*]Display more accurate heart levels
[*]Display more information on item mouseovers, including items that are still needed for bundles
[*]View calendar and quest billboard anywhere
[*]Display icons over animals that need petting
[*]Display crop type and days until harvest
[*]Display icon when animal has item yield (milk, wool)
[*]Sprinkler, scarecrow, beehive and Junimo hut ranges
[*]Display NPC locations on the map
[*]Skip the intro by pressing the Escape key
[*]Display an icon for Queen of Sauce when she is airing a recipe you don't already know
[*]Display an icon when Clint is upgrading one of your tools. Icon will tell you how long until the tool is finished and shows you which tool you are upgrading.
[*]Display an icon for items that can be donated to the museum for the Complete Collection achievement
[*]Display an icon for items that can be shipped for the Full Shipment achievement
[*]Display an icon for the next day's weather conditions
[*]... and also a new tab was added to the options menu that allows turning each individual mod on or off whenever you want.
[/list]

[size=4][u]Known Issues[/u][/size]

[list]
[*]In multiplayer only the host can see the correct location of NPC's on the map. If you face this issue, use the mod NPC Map Locations by Bouhm, which solves this problem. As it is a mod specialized for extending the map, it gets priority before UI Info Suite 2 and disables this mod's map features!﻿
[/list]


[size=4][u]Compatibility is assured with:[/u][/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] by Bouhm (gets priority before UI Info Suite 2 and disables this mod's map features)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url] by spacechase0
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1471]Level Extender[/url] by DevinLematty (probably?)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296]Better Farm Animal Variety[/url] by Parite

﻿[size=4][u]Install[/u][/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod, then either install it with your preferred mod manager or unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
